stem: To prepare 2-ethoxy-2-methylpropane from 2-methylpropan-2-ol, which reagent sequence is most suitable?

verdicts.working: Na converts 2-methylpropan-2-ol to tert-butoxide, which reacts with ethyl bromide by Williamson ether synthesis to form 2-ethoxy-2-methylpropane.

working:
$\text{Na}+(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{COH}\rightarrow(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{CONa}+\dfrac12\text{H}_2$; $(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{CONa}+\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{Br}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{S_N2}}(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{COC}_2\text{H}_5+\text{NaBr}$

Independent check: Na converts 2-methylpropan-2-ol to tert-butoxide, which reacts with ethyl bromide by Williamson ether synthesis to form 2-ethoxy-2-methylpropane.
